global_identity.color_palette: the colors of the product's packaging
global_identity.text_typography: a heavy bold sans for the headline in ALL CAPS, a clean sans for the rest

visual_prompt:
PRODUCT: VITALDROPS. Its bottle reproduced with total fidelity to the attached photo (label, brand name letter by letter, colors).
LAYOUT (before/after): the image split in 2 halves; two clearly different moments of the SAME woman (different clothes, different pose, in some cases a different place); the body change is obvious at first glance in the body area of the angle; small labels ANTES / DESPUÉS; Z1 headline at the top; the bottle between the two photos or at the bottom; Z5 offer as a ribbon along the bottom.
MODEL: a 55 years old woman, tall and slender, light olive skin, shoulder-length brown hair, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup. Emotion: Antes y después de su mañana, no de su cuerpo: asesora de call center que antes salía a las carreras con un tinto solo y cara de cansancio; después, sentada con su plato servido y su gotero, sonriendo con calma..
SETTING: by a residential swimming pool, sunny day. POSE AND FRAMING: leaning on a wall, side view, full body framing.

text_layers.text: MÁS GANAS DE COMER SIN TRAGAR PASTILLAS
text_layers.text_style: very bold, ALL CAPS, high contrast, the biggest text

text_layers.reference_position: on or next to the bottle
inside or right below the offer

mandatory_visual_elements: the real product from the attached product photo, at least 15% of the image
the woman: a 55 years old woman, tall and slender, light olive skin, shoulder-length brown hair, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup
final_generation_exclusions: any text closer than 5% to the edges
medical claims, guarantees or invented numbers
brands or logos other than the product

forbidden_additions: prices other than the given offer

language_rule: All visible text in Colombian Spanish, simple, perfectly spelled.
